## Install

1. Download **Clixy-Setup.exe** below and run it. No admin rights needed.
2. Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"* because the app isn't code-signed yet: click **More info → Run anyway**.
3. Paste your Claude API key when Clixy asks (get one at [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys)), pick a buddy, pick a shortcut.
4. Hold **Ctrl + Win**, ask out loud, let go.

**Clixy-portable.zip** is the same app without an installer: unzip anywhere and run `Clixy.exe`.

Your key stays on your PC, encrypted by Windows Credential Manager. Listening and the voice run on your PC. Only your screenshot and question go to Claude, when you ask.
